name: Log Viewer
description: 大日志文件查看器：GB 级流式分页、虚拟滚动、实时跟随、搜索高亮、文本/等级过滤、钉住对比。Log viewer for huge files: paging, tail, search, filter, pin.
author: Tioit-Wang

en.name: Log Viewer
en.description: Large log file viewer: GB-scale streaming paging, virtual scrolling, live tail-follow, search highlight, text/level filters and pinned lines.
en.safetyNotes: Opens only the .log/.txt files you pick or drag in, reads them read-only inside the plugin process; writes nothing and performs no network calls.

zh-CN.name: 日志查看器
zh-CN.description: 大日志文件查看器：GB 级流式分页、虚拟滚动、实时跟随、搜索高亮、文本/等级过滤、钉住对比。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 仅打开你选择或拖入的 .log / .txt 文件，在插件进程内只读访问；不写入文件，不发起网络请求。
